findings.source_quote: Three months later the colostomy was closed by termino-terminal manual anastomosis.
findings.explanation: The label lists the closure anastomosis but omits that it closed the colostomy, an important procedural detail.

findings.source_quote: After bowel disimpaction, the condition was treated with daily BM with Peristeen® transanal irrigation.
findings.explanation: The note says irrigation began after bowel disimpaction; it does not place treatment onset at age 16. The label transfers the symptom-onset anchor to treatment.

findings.label_excerpt: Laparoscopic left hemicolectomy with primary reanastomosis and temporary loop colostomy
findings.source_quote: The patient underwent a laparoscopic left emicolectomy with primary reanastomosis and temporary loop colostomy.
findings.explanation: The procedure description is source-supported; the supplied excerpt does not establish a material discrepancy in this field.

initial.summary: The treatment timing is anchored to age 16 without support; the note instead places treatment after bowel disimpaction. The label also omits that the later anastomosis closed the colostomy.
